title: Truth by measured outcome: labels only where the numbers can tell, a tuning judged on a fresh draw of its replica
request: Phase 7 (the owner): a student behind every choice; 29.3 labels the outcome points by what was measured after the choice, from self-play alone and from every workspace.
plan: Write a measured label on each outcome point from the numbers recorded after the choice, where the capture already writes the decision.
Record self-play's verified solves again so their ledgers carry the labels, and build the per-point sets from those ledgers into the lake.
Test a planted bad choice labelled wrong and read into its set, and self-play rows grouped by solve.

decisions.decision: A recipe or family choice is labelled only when one option leads every other by more than their combined fold spread.
decisions.why: The highest validation mean inside the folds' noise is no truth: a label copying it marked the rule wrong where it had declined a gap a sixth of a fold standard deviation wide, and a student trained on it would copy noise.

decisions.decision: The metric's direction comes from the engine (a kind's machine, the tabular spec, or the stage record), and nothing is labelled when it is unknown.
decisions.why: MAE, MASE and the Brier score are better when lower; ranking by the highest mean labelled the worst regression family as best.

decisions.decision: A tuning is judged on a fresh draw of its replica (the default and the candidate fitted and scored there, a paired bootstrap), and only on self-play.
decisions.why: The rule keeps a tuning on validation; any label from the same validation agrees with it or says nothing; the holdout scores only the kept configuration, and scoring the default there too would be a second use of it: the owner's call.

decisions.decision: No label for a holdout read again.
decisions.why: A constant written as measured measures nothing, outranks a person's label and contradicts the validator, which allows a person's reuse with a reason.

decisions.decision: The label rule lives in dclab_core (measured.clear_best), its evidence kinds in DecisionLabel v4.
decisions.why: The main product's model comparisons can label their choices the same way.

change: dclab_core/measured.py (clear_best), DecisionLabel v4 with the evidence kinds validation_clear_best and fresh_draw (dclab-core 0.82.0); capture labels features.recipe and model.family where validation tells them apart, and a person's or the intern's other choice the same way; kinds/forecasting.py marks the options the rule may not choose; lake/replicate.py judges a self-play tuning on a fresh draw; selfplay records it, builds per-point decision rows from the ledgers of whole verified solves (a failed re-recording or a run stopped before its holdout gives none), re-records with --since; the lake reads them under the evaluation seeds' rule; answers.attach skips answers kept without the fingerprint of their question.

findings.defect: The family and recipe labels copied fold noise.
findings.scenario: rare_event case 2: the rule kept logistic regression at 0.4535 plus or minus 0.244; the label named xgboost at 0.4922 plus or minus 0.19; 12 of 19 family labels contradicted the rule.
findings.cause: The label was the highest validation mean, read from the same numbers the rule had already weighed.
findings.fix: clear_best: a label only when one option leads every other by more than their combined spread.
findings.impact: Every student of these points would have learned to copy the noisiest high mean and beaten its rule on dev for that reason alone.

findings.defect: The labels assumed higher is better.
findings.scenario: A regression run: MAE means ridge 8.58, extra trees 9.23; the label named extra trees, the worst.
findings.cause: The maximum of the means was taken whatever the metric.
findings.fix: The direction from the engine; unknown, no label.

findings.defect: The tuning label compared numbers that cannot be compared.
findings.scenario: rare_event case 2: a tuning gain of 0.020 beside a validation-to-holdout gap of 0.043; a narrow interval would label the shift, not the tuning.
findings.cause: The tuned model's holdout interval was set against the default's validation mean.
findings.fix: The label removed for real projects; on self-play, a fresh draw of the replica's process scores both configurations.
alternatives: Score the default on the same holdout read: a second use of the holdout, left to the owner.
Validate again on another fold partition of the training rows: the same rows, weaker.

findings.defect: From self-play alone the outcome points had one class.
findings.scenario: On the first re-recorded solves every recipe label equalled the rule's choice and no family label existed.
findings.cause: The label and the rule read the same validation numbers: an option clear by the combined spread is almost always the rule's pick.
findings.fix: The fresh-draw tuning label gives both classes; a person's or the intern's other choice is labelled by the same rule.
findings.open: Recipe and family labels from self-play remain almost all the rule's own answer.

findings.defect: A holdout read again got a constant label written as measured.
findings.scenario: Every reuse labelled wrong, even one the validator allowed with a person's reason, and even when the move was refused.
findings.cause: A rule's verdict was written as a measurement.
findings.fix: No label for holdout.reuse; the rule's answer stays on the record.

findings.defect: A failed or half-written self-play solve was read as verified.
findings.scenario: A ledger folder held 27 records from an interrupted re-recording (no models or final records) while done.jsonl said verified.
findings.cause: Only the original verified flag was read.
findings.fix: A solve counts when verified, not failed when recorded again, and its ledger reached the holdout; each exclusion counted.

findings.defect: An option the rule may not choose could be labelled best.
findings.scenario: Forecasting's seasonal naive baseline, or a model scored on fewer, easier series.
findings.cause: Every option with a mean was ranked.
findings.fix: Forecasting marks those options not eligible; clear_best skips them.

findings.defect: A real-run test passed without a label.
findings.scenario: Binary and regression case 5 give no clear best: the test compared an empty list with an empty list.
findings.cause: The cases were chosen without checking they label anything.
findings.fix: Binary case 3 and a forecasting run (lower is better), with at least two labels required.

findings.defect: A lake build could crash during a re-recording, and --since was compared as text.
findings.scenario: A ledger folder replaced while read; a since time with a space sorted after marks with a T.
findings.cause: Files read without a guard; ISO strings compared lexically.
findings.fix: A folder that changes is skipped and counted; times parsed.

findings.defect: make lake failed on Claude's captured answers.
findings.scenario: KeyError input_fingerprint in answers.attach once Claude's silver answers were kept under bronze/answers/claude.
findings.cause: Those answers were kept in another shape, without the fingerprint of their question.
findings.fix: An answer without a fingerprint is counted and never attached.

measurements.name: self-play's outcome points
measurements.gate: Done when: the outcome points have sets with both labels from self-play alone
measurements.result: 193 verified solves re-recorded: tuning.accept 26 measured labels (23 do not keep, 3 keep; the rule right on 23, wrong on 3); model.family 51 (the rule wrong on 1); features.recipe 19 (all the rule's); the lake's gold tuning.accept set 20 rows (13 train, 4 dev, 3 sealed)
measurements.against_gate: Both labels for tuning.accept and model.family; not for features.recipe; none for holdout.reuse, experiment.accept, threshold.operating_point or metric.primary.
limits: Invented problems of one process per kind: a fresh draw says how a tuning generalises there, not on a real table.
The rule's errors are few: 3 tunings and 1 family in 193 solves.

measurements.name: the planted bad tuning
measurements.gate: Done when: a planted bad choice is labelled wrong by the rule and read into its set
measurements.result: A ridge candidate with a huge penalty kept by the rule is labelled do not keep by the fresh draw, and the set's label reads it
limits: Judged on a fresh draw of the replica, not on the holdout as the plan first wrote.

outcome: The outcome points now carry labels the numbers can defend: a choice is called wrong only where validation clearly says so, and a tuning only where new rows of the same process say so; self-play gives a tuning label in both directions and reaches the lake.
lessons: A label read from the numbers the rule already weighed can only agree with the rule or copy its noise: truth needs a measurement the rule did not see.
Take the metric's direction from the code that chose it, never from a default.
A planted generator is a second sample for free: use it where the project's own data has no second look.
risks: Real projects' tunings stay unlabelled until the owner decides about the holdout.
The gold family and recipe sets shrink to a few rows after the evaluation seeds and duplicates are dropped.
